title: curtain_call-16.flac by Halleck
author: Halleck
sourceDescription: Applause and cheering of a crowd during a curtain call. The cheering and clapping varies in intensity as different actors come out to take their bows. Some spontaneous cheering at the end, too- the lights went out but the crowd could still see the drummer's glow-in-the-dark "Green Lantern" shirt. Recorded with a Canon GL-2 internal microphone.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain -2.00 dB (peak -2.40 dBFS); 30 ms fades
